tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi bsdus don bzhugs so//

༄༅// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bsgrub thabs 'di la bzhi ste/ sgrub thabs kyi mtshan dang*/ sgrub pa'i gang zag dang*/ gang bsgom pa'i don dang*/ bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ bskyed rims dang*/ rdzogs rims so// dang po la gnyis/ dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// sngon 'gro la gnyis/ rgyu'i yan lag dang*/ rgyu dngos so// dang po la gsum/ rnal 'byor bsrung ba tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom pa/ bdag bsrung ba lha'i rnal 'byor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o// bar pa la lnga/ mdor bstan/ phung po/ skye mched/ khams lha'i bdag nyid bsgom pa/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ rgyu dngos la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs so// dang po la gnyis/ mchod pa'i yul bsgom pa dang*/ mchod pa dngos so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ brtags pa'i stong nyid dang*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o// dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bskyed rims spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis 'byung ba rims brtsegs dang*/ rten pa lha bskyed pa'o// de la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i cho ga dang*/ bskyed pa dngos so// de la gnyis/ rdzus skyes dngos dang*/ rnam pa gsal gdab pa'o// de la lnga/ gtso bo dang*/ bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ dur khrod gsal gdab pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ phyogs gang du dgod pa dang*/ sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan no// bye brag tu bstan pa la gsum/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ sbyar ba'i chos sku dang*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa longs sku dang*/ yan lag bsgom pa sprul sku'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la bdun/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang*/ dbang po/ stobs/ byang chub kyi yan lag

'phags pa'i lam/ yang dag par spong ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ sku gsung thugs/ mjug bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ mkha' spyod pa gnyis su dag pa/ sa spyod pa drug pa/ sa 'og spyod pa sa bcu gnyis dag pa'o// sprul sku bsgom pa la gnyis/ yab yum gyi go cha gnyis/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la drug /yab yum gyi go cha/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa dngos/ dbang bskur ba/ bzlas pa bya ba/ mchod de bstod pa/ phyi nang gi gtor ma'o// rjes la gsum/ khams dpa' bo'i dag pa/ rgyan sngags kyi dag pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dag pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyas bshad dang*/ mjug bsdu ba'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa la bzhi/ bde ba chen po'i rdzogs rims/ dam tshig sems dpa'/ gzugs las 'das pa/ zhar la thabs dang shes rab kyi rdzogs rims so// bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu la gnyis/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang bar dor mchog grub tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ thabs dang shes rab kyi 'bras bu dang*/ de bzhin nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i 'bras bu'o// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal lū hi pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi bsdus don/ rang byung rdo rje zhes bya bas sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i mngon rtogs lū hi pa'i bzhed pa bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por re shig rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ bdud rtsi'i ri lus kha dag par byas te/ dpal he ru ka'i don dran pas lus ngag yid kyi dri ma sbyang ste zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya'o// de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du byams pa dang snying rjes dga' ba dang btang snyoms tshad med pa bsgom par bya'o// de nas gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad/ 'tshogs khar dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu can/

tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma lte bar ser po rin po che dang dril bu/ 'du shes kyi phung po la pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug mgrin par dmar po pad ma dang dril bu/ 'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po rkang bol du ljang khu/ rgya gram dang dril bu/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa' snying khar dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid dpal he ru ka rdo rje dpal 'bar mthing kha rdo rje dang dril bu can no// mig gnyis la gti mug rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje mthing kha rdo rje dang dril bu/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ser po rin po che dang dril bu/ lce la 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po pad ma dang dril bu/ reg la phrag dog rdo rje nor bu la ljang khu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu/ skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje/ nu ma'i bar du dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu can/ thams cad kyang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang*/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa'o// sa'i khams la ltung bar byed ma lte bar ser mo g.yas dang po ḍa ma ru/ chu'i khams la gsod par byed ma snying khar sngon mo g.yas dang po na rdo rje/ me'i khams la 'gugs par byed ma mgrin par dmar mo/ g.yas dang po na pad ma/ rlung gi khams la gar gyi dbang phyug ma spyi bor ljang khu g.yas dang po na sna tshogs rdo rje/ thams cad kyi g.yas gnyis pa na gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwam̐ ga dang thod pa'o/ nam mkha'i khams la pad ma'i dra ba can ma/ spyi gtsug tu mthing dmar dbus mthing g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas na lcags kyu dang tshangs pa'i mgo dang gri gug g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭwām̐ ga dang zhags pa/ thams cad kyang rol pa'i khro mo phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa gnas bsrung ba ni/ oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ghri rna ghri rna hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ghri rna pa ya ghri rna pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga ban badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyogs rnams su g.yon bskor du/ khwa dang 'ug pa dang khyi dang phag gi gdong can rnams dgod do// yang g.yas bskor du gshin rje bsreg ma dang*/ mche ba ma dang*/ pho nya ma dang*/ 'joms ma rnams so// 'og tu hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od zer dang bcas pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir byin gyis brlab bo// oṃ me di ni badzra ba badzra bhan dha hūm̐/ lha mo rnams kyi nang rol du sngags las gyur pa'i rdo rje'i ra ba dang gur rnams ni oṃ badzra pra ka ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra paṇa tsa ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bi tha na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dza la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ zhes pas rdo rje ra ba gru bzhi pa dang*/ gur dang bla re dang*/ mda'i dra ba rnams byin gyis brlab bo// de nas kha la sogs pa rnams kyi mdun du hūm̐ las dong kha khyer can du gyur par blta ste/ 'od zer gyis bgegs kyi tshogs bkug cing dong gi nang du bcug nas phur bus gdab par bya'o/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba du ṣṭa na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ki la ya ki la ya sarba pa pam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra ki la ya badzra dha ro ad dzña pa ya ti sarba pa pam̐ sarba dshtun bi gha nang ka ya bag tsi ta badzra ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra mud ka ra badzra ki la ya a ko ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces tho bas brdung bar bya'o// de ltar bgegs rnams med par bya ste/ lha mo thams cad bsdus nas/ badzra pra ka ra na hūm̐/ pad ma pra ka ra na hūm̐/ tsakra pra ka ra na hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje dang pad ma dang*/ 'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po bya ste/ mtshams bcing par bya'o// thams cad la badzra dza la a na la rka hūm̐ hūm̐ gis ni kha dog lngar byin gyis brlabs te bdag dang gnas bsrung ngo*// de nas rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba bsgoms te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gsal bar lta ste/ snying kha'i 'od zer las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ a badzra bhi ne hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra bam̐ se hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra mu ran tse hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra mu kun dha hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra ha se hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra lasye hūṃ/ oṃ a badzra ghir ti hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra nir ti hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra pu pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra dhi pe hūṃ/ oṃ a badzra ghan dhe hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra dhar she hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra ra sye hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra par she hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra dhar me hūm̐/ zhes pi wang ma sngon mo/ gling bu ma ser mo/ rdza rnga ma ljang khu/ rnga zlum ma dmar mo/ bzhad ma dmar skya/ sgeg mo sngon mo/ glu ma ser mo/ gar ma ljang khu/ me tog ma dkar mo/ bdug spos ma mthing kha/ mar me ma dmar ser/ dri chab ma dkar mo/ gzugs ma dkar mo/ ro ma dmar mo/ reg ma ljang khu/ chos ma dkar mos te rig ma bcu drug ming dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa rnams kyis phyi dang/ oṃ paṇa tsa a mri ta pu tsa mi gha sa mun tra pa ra na sa ma ye hūṃ gis mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas nang dang*/ yab yum gnyis su med pa'i bde ba gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*/ mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba/ de kho na nyid kyis mchod de bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags go /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// byang chub myur du bdag skyabs mchi// 'gro ba kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// zhes pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags te de nyid kyi rjes su lha rnams snying khar bsdus te/ oṃ sa bha bā shud dho sarba dharma sa bha bā shud dho ham̐ gis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o// he ru ka a ham̐ zhes bdag kyang hūm̐ la bsdu bar bya'o// oṃ shu n+ya ta dzña na badzra sa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐ zhes/

nā dar yang mi dmigs pa la gnas par bya ba ye shes kyi tshogs so// de nas rten dang brten pa ni stong pa'i ngang las rnam par shes pa nā dar gyur par blta ste/ de la 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa/ sum̐ las lhun po rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad ma/ de dag gi steng du bhrum̐ las gzhal yas kyi khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa ka ba brgyad kyis nyer bar mdzes pa/ dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa sngar bstan pa lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa bskyed do// de nas nā da las a li tshan pa sum cu rtsa bdun byung bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa bdun de nyid kyis mtshan pa'o// de nyid dang mnyam pa'i ka li nyi ma'i bdag nyid can no// de nas nā da de dbus kyi nyi zla'i bar du zhugs pas/ hūm̐ bam̐ ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can du gyur par blta'o// gzhan rnams su mam̐ lam̐ pam̐ tam̐/ pu dza o a go ra de mā/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku/ hūm̐ brgyad zhugs cing de rnams la 'od 'phros pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don byas slar 'dus pas/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis su gyur par blta ste/ khyad par du gtso bo'i thugs kar pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la dbus su bdag lta bu mkha' 'gro bzhi dang byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i snod bzhi dang bcas pa blta'o// phyi rol dang nang dbyer med par gsal gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing kha mdun mthing g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ ral pa'i thor tsugs zla ba phyed pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbu rgyan can/

zhal rnam par 'gyur ba mche ba gtsigs pa sgeg pa dang dpa' ba 'jigs su rung pa/ rgod pa gshe ba 'jigs su rung bar byed pa snying rje ba rngam zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bus yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags pa na bzar brgyangs pa/ g.yas gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa'o// g.yon gsum pa na kha ṭwām̐ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa'o/ yum rdo rje phag mo zhal cig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o// dang po mkha' 'gro ma dang la ma dang dum skyes ma dang*/ gzugs can ma/ g.yon bskor du zhal gyi kha dog can/ zhal cig phyag bzhi ma g.yas ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon na kha ṭwā ga dang thod pa can no// mtshams rnams su byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i snod bzhi dgod do// de nas dang po thugs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la kha dog sngon po rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas rnam par rgyan pa de'i shar phyogs kyi rtsibs pu li ra ma la yar/ spyi bor thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang phyogs kyi rtsibs dza lan dha rar spyi gtsug tu keng rus chen po dang gtum mig ma/ nub phyogs kyi rtsibs dbu rgyan rna ba g.yas par keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs kyi rtsibs ar ltar mgo bo'i rgyab tu mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang*/ sna chen ma gnas/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba'o// me'i mtshams kyi rtsibs ko ta wa rir rna ba g.yon par chang dkra dang dpa' ba'i blo gros ma/ bden bral gyi phyogs kyi rtsibs ra mi sha ra smin ma'i dbus su snang ba dpag med dang*/ mi thung ma/ rlung gi phyogs kyi rtsibs dhe wi ko ṭa mig gnyis su rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs ma la bar dpung pa'i mgor rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib mo nye ba'i gnas sa dri ma med pa'o// 'di dag ni thugs kyi 'khor lo ste nam mkha' la spyod pa'o// gnyis pa gsung gi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dmar po/

pad ma dmar po'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba de'i shar phyogs kyi rtsibs ka ma ru pa mchan khung gnyis su myug gu can dang sa bsrungs ma/ byang phyogs kyi rtsibs o tra nu ma gnyis la rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo zhing*/ sa 'od byed ma'o// nub phyogs kyi rtsibs tri sha ku ner lte ba'i dbus su dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho phyogs kyi rtsibs ko sa la sna'i rtse mor rdo rje hūm̐ ka ra dang chang 'thung ma nye ba'i zhing*/ sa 'od 'phro ba'o// me'i phyogs kyi rtsibs ka ling ka kha la rab tu bzang po dang sngon bsangs lha mo/ bden bral phyogs kyi rtsibs lam pa ka mgrin par rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ tshan dho ha sa sbyang dka' ba'o// rlung gi phyogs kyi rtsibs kan rtsir snying khar 'jigs byed chen mo dang rta rna ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs hi ma la yar lgang par mig mi bzang dang mkha' 'gro gdong ma'o// nye ba'i tshan dho ha/ sa mngon du gyur pa'o// gsung gi 'khor lo ste sa la spyod pa'o// gsum pa sku'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po 'khor lo dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i shar phyogs kyi rtsibs pre ta pu rar mtshan ma la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs ma/ byang phyogs kyi rtsibs gri ha de ba ta gshang lam du rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma 'du ba can/ sa ring du song ba'o// nub phyogs rtsibs sau'u raṣṭa brla gnyis la rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ lho phyogs kyi rtsibs so'u warna di pa byin pa gnyis la/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o// nye ba'i du ba can/ sa mi g.yo ba'o// me'i phyogs kyi rtsibs na ga ra sor mo rnams la/ dpal khrag 'thung dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bden bral gyi phyogs kyi rtsibs si dhu/ rkang pa'i bol gnyis su pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen mo/ dur khrod sa legs pa'i blo gros so// rlung gi phyogs kyi rtsibs ma ru/

mthe bong gnyis la rnam par snang byed dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ dbang ldan gyi rtsibs ku lu ta pus mo gnyis la/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo'o// nye ba'i dur khrod/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin no// sku'i 'khor lo ste sa 'og la spyod pa'o// dpa' bo thams cad zhal cig phyag bzhi pa dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bus yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yon 'og ma na kha ṭwām̐ ga /g.yas ḍa ma ru'o// gzhan dag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam pa can no// yum rnams ni rdo rje phag mo ci lta ba sa bcu'i bdag nyid rnams so// shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i sgo rnams su/ khwa dang 'ug pa dang*/ khyi dang phag gi gdong pa can dang*/ mthing kha dang ljang khu dang dmar mo dang ser mo rnams so// shar lho mtshams nas g.yas bskor du gshin rje sreg ma dang*/ pho nya ma dang*/ mche ba can dang*/ 'joms ma rnams de gzugs ma gnyis ma'o// nang du ni/ kha dang sna dang gsang ba dang gshang ba'i gnas dang*/ rna ba g.yas dang g.yon pa dang*/ mig g.yas dang g.yon rnams su go rims bzhin no// thams cad kyang g.yas gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon gnyis na kha ṭwām̐ ga dang thod pa can ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o// phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad ni shar phyogs nas g.yon bskor du gtum drag tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ 'jigs su rung pa/ byang shar nas g.yas bskor du ha ha dgod pa/ dpal gyi nags tshal/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki la sgrogs pa'o// de dag tu go rims bzhin/ shir sha/ a sha ta/ kang ke li/ tsu ta bha tra/ ka ra dza/ pa ra ka ta/ pa ti pa/ shing brgyad do// dbang po dkar po rdo rje thogs pa glang po che la zhon pa/ gnod sbyin ser po bāe tsa pu ri thogs pa rta la zhon pa/ chu lha dkar po sbrul zhags thogs pa chu srin la zhon pa/ gshin rje nag po dbyug pa thogs pa ma he la zhon pa/ bde byed dkar po rtse gsum thogs pa khyu mchog la zhon pa/

me lha dmar po me thab thogs pa ra la zhon pa/ rlung lha ljang khu ba dan thogs pa sha ba la zhon pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad ma can/ pad ma chen po hu lu ru/ rigs ldan dung skyong*/ shing skyong zhon pa'i mgo can gri gug dang thod pa can no// sgra sgrogs rmugs 'byin/ drag po 'khyil pa/ stug po snying po char 'bebs gtum pa rnams so// gzhan yang chu dang me dang*/ rnal 'byor la sogs pa dur khrod phun sum tshogs pa'o// de nas lha thams cad la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab po// oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi ni ka ya bag tsi ta badzra sa bha ba ad ma ko haṃ gis phyi rol dang nang gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid du byin gyis brlab po// oṃ badzra shud dho sarba dharma badzra shud dho ham̐ gis bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mos par bya'o// oṃ ha na ma hi/ sa ha hūm̐/ bho shad he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho phaṭa kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi snying kha dang*/ tshogs ma dang*/ spyi gtsug dang*/ 'phrag pa dang/ mig dang/ yan lag thams cad la mtshon cha'o// oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yam̐/ hriṃ maṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bya bas bcom ldan 'das ma'i lte ba/ snying kha/ 'tshogs ma/ spyi gtsug yan lag thams cad la dgod par bya'o// spros pa la dga' ba dag gis lha'i rnam par dgod de/ de nas sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor bas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo ji ltar bskyed pa lta bu dgug cing*/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho zhes gzhug par bya'o// ye shes kyi 'khor lo de nyid la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes brjod cing gsol ba btab la/ lha tshogs rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

zhes dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ yo ga shud dha sarba dharma yo ga shud dho haṃ gis yid dag pa'i bdag nyid du blta ste/ dbang bskur ba'i rjes su gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ bde chen gyi lha mo bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la snang ba mtha' yas/ sku'i 'khor lo la rnam par mdzad/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la don yod grub pa rnams kyis rgyas btab par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ la rdo rje dkar po bhya dmar pos mtshan pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i chos 'byung a las pad ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa dyas mtshan pa gnyis su med pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyi lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa dang dpral bar yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po dang*/ bdag nyid kyi snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po go rims bzhin dgod cing yul la'ang bzlog pa'i rim pas bkod de/ dbang gi don dran par bya'o// bdud rtsi myang ba ni lag pa'i mchod pa ltar ro// de ltar sgyu ma lta bu'i sku la sems rtse cig tu bsgom par bya'o// bzlas pa ni bzlas pa'i man ngag las shes par bya ba yin no// sngags kyi mchod pa la sogs pa ni phyi rol gyi mchod pa las shes so/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni sa bon las 'od 'phros te/ brtan g.yo thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gyur te bsdus la lte bar a li ka lir gyur pa la thim zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal cig phyag gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud par gyur te/ bde ba chen por bsdus la byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i gong bur gyur cing*/ de yang hūm̐ dang na da dang chos kyi dbyings su spros pa thams cad dang bral ba la mnyam par bzhag go /gtor ma'ang gtor ma'i cho ga las ji ltar byung ba bzhin no// mngon par rtogs pa shin du bsdus pa bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes ci lta ba yi ger rang byung rdo rjes bkod pa 'di re shig rdzogs so/// /

༈ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi mngon rtogs nag po pa'i bzhed pa bzhugs so// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan he ru ka dpal dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor can// rnam par rgyal sogs 'khor lo la// rab tu 'bad pas phyag byas nas// spyod 'chang gsung gi 'od zer gyis// 'khor lo sdom pa pad ma'i tshal/ rgyud bzhin bye ba rab brling pa/ gsal bar bya phyir bshad par bya// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas sngags pas/ mngal skyes kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la rnal 'byor du byed par 'dod pas/ snga bar yi ge bdun pa'am rnal 'byor ma'i glus sad par mos te stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ bdud rtsi'i ri lus kha lag dag par byas te/ rang nyid dpal he ru ka'o zhes lus sbyangs nas/ ngag a li ka li dang yid bde ba chen por byas nas/ dang po'i sbyor ba ni/ nyi zla'i sa bon 'od tshogs kyis// mdun du bde gshegs spyan drangs la// mchod pa kun gyis legs mchod nas// dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa brjod// zhes byung bas/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i snying khar/ ma las nyi ma a las zla'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba bsgoms te/ de'i 'od kyis mdun du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bla ma dang bcas par gsal bar bsgoms la/ snying kha'i sngags kyi 'od zer las/ pi wang ma sngon mo/ gling bu ma ser mo/ rdza rnga ma dmar mo/ rnga zlum ma ljang khu/ bzhad ma dmar mo/ sgeg mo sngon mo/ klu ma ser mo/ gar ma ljang khu/ me tog ma dkar mo/ bdug spos ma mthing kha/ mar me ma dkar ser/ dri chab ma dkar sngo/ gzugs ma dkar mo/ ro ma dmar mo/ reg ma ljang khu/ chos ma dkar mo/ phyag dang pos so so'i mchod pa 'dzin cing*/ 'og ma rdo rje dril bu can rnams kyis mchod de/ oṃ a badzra bhi ni hūm̐/

oṃ a badzra bam̐ se hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra mu ran tse hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra mu kun te hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra ha se hūṃ/ oṃ a badzra lwa se hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra ghir ti hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra nir ti hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra puṣpe hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra dhu pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra dhi pe hūm̐/ oṃ a badzra ghan dhe hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadzra dhar she hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadzra ra se hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra par she hūm̐/ oṃ aḥbadzra dhar me hūm̐/ zhes lha mo bcu drug dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas mchod nas/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byas te/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ 'gro bas dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrubs phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad pa bzhin// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /ces brjod cing de'i don bsgom/ de tshad med pa bzhi rgya cher bsgoms/ de nas thams cad stong par bsgoms te/ sna tshogs pad ma nyi rdo rjer// hūm̐ 'byung mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis// blo bzang gis ni phur sogs bya// zhes byung bas/ oṃ swa bha ba shud dho sarba dharma sa bha ba shud dho ha/ zhes bya ba dang mchod byed bsdus te/ hūm̐ du gyur par bltas la/ hūm̐ shu n+ya ta dzña na badzra sa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes na da kyang bzlas pa'i stong pa nyid bsgoms/ de ltar bsod nams dang ye shes kyi rgyu las ldang bar bsgoms pa ni/ na da las slar 'od 'phros pas/ paṃ las pad ma ljang khu/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las sum bha ni sum bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ghri na ghri na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ghri hṇa pa ya ghri hṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ a na ya ho bha ga bān/ bhirya ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces g.yon bskor dang*/ g.yas bskor lan gnyis su shar la sogs pa'i phyogs dang mtshams su'o// sngags kyi 'od zer las/ shar du khwa dang*/ byang du 'ug pa dang*/ nub tu khyi dang*/ lhor phag pa'i gdong can dang*/ mer sreg ma dang*/ bden bral du pho nya mo dang*/ rlung du mche ba ma dang*/ dbang ldan du mdzes ma rnams sku chen po g.yas tho ba dang g.yon phur bu can du bltas nas/ mdun du hūm̐ las rdo rje'i dong du phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad bkug cing bcug nas phur bus gdab po/ oṃ gha gha gha ta yagha ta ya/ sarba du st+ran hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ki la yā ki la yā sarba pa pam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra ki la yā badzra dha ra a dzña pa ya ti sarba duṣṭan bhig nan ka yā bāg tsi ta/ badzra ki la yā hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas tho bas brdungs te/ oṃ badzra mud ka ra badzra ki la yā/ a ko tra yā a ko tra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bde ba chen por byas nas thams cad 'bar bar byas la rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi dang*/ sa gzhi dang*/ zha la dang*/ bla re dang*/ mda'i dra ba dang*/ me dpung gis mtshams bcings te/ oṃ me dhi ni badzra bha bā badzra bhan dha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pra ka ra na hūm̐ sam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pan tsa ra tsa hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra bhin dha na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzwa la ḍaṃ saṃ ḍaṃ/ oṃ badzra dza la a na la ka hūm̐ hūm̐/ gis byin gyis brlab po/ gur bya ba'o// de'i dbus su blo dang ldan pas mkha' dbyings bsam/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rnams bsgoms pa// 'byung ba thams cad 'dus pa las// gang phyir sna tshogs gzhir gyur pa la/ zhes chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam nag po/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum dmar po/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ sum̐ las ri rab rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin can/

hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus kyi lte ba nag po/ pam̐ las sna tshogs pad ma/ de'i dbus su bhrum̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang*/ snam bu dang*/ pan tsa ra ga dang*/ pha gu dang*/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang*/ mda' yab dang pu shu nang ka ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi steng rim pas mtho ba la/ gdung char khebs tog dang ldan pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa bsgoms pa ni/ gzhal yas khang ngo*// de nas de'i dbus su/ dkar dmar sngo ba'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyis dbus su pam̐ las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du a li dang ka li dang ldan pa'i zla nyi'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros 'dus pas rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan/ de las rgyu'i he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ rgyab zhal ser ba/ rtsa ba'i phyag gis rdo rje dang dril bus shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ phyag lhag ma 'og nas 'byung ba lta bu/ phyag rgya drug dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o// gar gyi nyams dang ldan pa'o// zhal bzhi phyag ni bzhi pa nas// de bzhin phyag 'bum bar du ste// rgyal ba'i 'od zer sprin chen po// kun nas 'gro bar rnam par bsgoms// de yi shes rab drag chen mo// dum bus brgyan pa'i 'og pag can// rdo rje thod pas 'khyud pa ste// rang gi kha dog rgyan cha 'dzin// mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa bsgoms/ de nas sum pa la sogs pas// zhal bzhi byin gyis brlabs po// oṃ dharma dhar tu swa bha bā ad ma ko ham̐/ bsnyen pa'o// hūm̐ snying khar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ ma ma ki spyi bor rnam snang ser/ sa hā hūm̐/ spyi gtsug padma gar dbang dmar po/ bho shang he phrag par he ru ka sngon po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho mig tu rdo rje nyi ma ser po/

phaṭa hūm̐ yan lag thams cad la rta mchog ljang khu'o// yum la/ oṃ bam̐ lte bar phag mo dmar mo/ ham̐ yam̐ snying khar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ kha la hri mong rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ spyi bor hring hring spyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ sgrog byed ma sngon mo/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa gtum mo du ba'i mdog can te nye ba'i bsgrub pa'o/ snying khar hūm̐ zla ba la gnas pa/ thugs rdo rje'i/ mgrin par hri ha ha'i sngags gsungs rdo rje'i/ dpral bar shri he he'i sngags sku rdo rje'o// lha mo'i snying khar sarba bhud dha'o/ mgrin par oṃ bhe ro tsa na'i hūm̐ phaṭa do/ dpral bar bhe ro tsa na'o// spyi gtsug tu āoṃ/ snying khar hūm̐/ ze 'bru la āḥ rked par saḥ brla la ha/ mtshan ma gnyis la sngags sbyar/ sna rtser āḥ yi ge rnam par dgod/ bam̐ yig gis mtshan lte ba la/ blo ldan rnal 'byor ma la bsrub// ces bya ba bsgrub pa'o// de dag ni rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa'i cho ga'o// de nas bde ba chen po'i sbyor bas/ spyan drangs pa'i bde gshegs rnams// a ba 'du ti gnas de bzhin// smin ma'i bar na bzhugs par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta na badzra swa bha ad ma ko ham̐ḥ zhes bde ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa/ mam̐ lam̐ pam̐ tam̐/ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre ghri swo su na si ma ku/ hūm̐ brgyad kyis bar du gyur pa phag mo'i mkhar phab ste/ rang rang gi gdan la phyogs mtshams su spro bar bya'o// de nas mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/ gnas na rnam par 'gying ste/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma dkar ser/ byang du lā ma ljang ser/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar ser/ lhor gzugs can ma dkar ser/ thams cad ro'i gdan la gri thod can phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o// mtshams su sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba pad ma dang nyi ma la'o// de nas thugs kyi 'khor lo la/

shar du thod pa'i dum bu dang rab gtum mo/ byang du keng rus chen po dang gtum mig ma/ nub tu keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ lhor mche ba ma rnams par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ mer chang gra ha dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ lho nub tu 'od dpag med mi thung ma/ nub byang du rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar du rdo rje lus dang shing grib ma'o// thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' spyod ma/ snyom par 'jug pas yang dag gnas/ gnyis pa gsung gi 'khor lo la/ shar du myu gu can dang sa srungs ma/ byang du rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jig byed chen mo/ nub tu dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs ma/ lho ru rdo rje hūm̐ ka ra dang chang 'thungs ma'o// mer rab tu bzang mo dang sngo bsang lha mo'o// bden bral du rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ rlung du 'jigs byed chen po rta rna ma/ dbang ldan du mig mi bzang dang mkha' 'gro gdong ma'o// gsung gi 'khor lo sa spyod ma// snyoms par 'jug pa yang dag gnas// gsum pa sku'i 'khor lo la shar du stobs po che dang 'khor lo yi shugs ma/ byang du rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ nub tu rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ lhor nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mer dpal khrag 'thung ma dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bden bral du pad ma dkar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rlung du rnam par snang byed dang 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson chen ma ste/ sku'i 'khor lo sa 'og spyod/ snyoms par 'jug pa yang dag gnas/ shar du khwa gdong*/ byang du 'ug gdong*/ nub tu khyi gdong*/ lhor phag gdong*/ mer gshin rje sreg ma/ bden bral du pho nya mo/ rlung du mche ba can/ dbang ldan du 'joms ma ste/ mtshams kyi kha dog go /sngo dmar dkar dang phyogs kyi rdo rje dril bus 'khyud pa dang*/ gri gug thod pas 'khyud pas te/ ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la dgod/

dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni he ru ka dpal rigs las byung*/ rnal 'byor ma ni nyi shu bzhi/ phag mo yi ni rigs byung ba'o// spyan gsum mche gtsigs thod phreng brgyan// mgur chu gtsug phud dpung brgyan dang*// gdug bskor tshangs skud 'gul pa'i rgyan// ske rags sil sil sgra sgrogs pa'i// de bzhin ma mo brgyad po ni// stag gi lpags pas sham thabs can// de ltar ma lus 'khor lo bsgom// dkyil 'khor spro ba'i rim pa'o// kha sbyor sbyar bar gyur pa las// rdo rje lu gu rgyud du brjod// rdo rje pad ma dbye bya zhing*// de ni bung ba lha 'khor bya// lcags kyu nyid kyis dgug bya zhing*// gtun shing gis ni bkrug bya ste// kun nas 'bigs byed mda' sbyor bas// rig ma lhan cig zhu bar gyur// de ltar bcom ldan 'das yab yum byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu bar gyur te/ de la sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa yin/ myur zhing skyen par bdag la bskul/ oṃ ma hā su kha badzra sa twa dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho su ra ta stam̐ tri sha ho/ zhes klus bskul bas oṃ a hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du gyur te de las gyur pas 'bras bu'i he ru kar gyur par blta ste/ nyi ma dang 'jigs byed dus mtshan la gnas pa/ zhal bzhi ste/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ rgyab ser ba/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi rtsa bas rdo rje dang dril bus shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ gnyis kyis glang po'i lpags pa khrag dang bcas pa na bzar brgyangs pa/ g.yas gsum pa ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra sta/ lnga pa gri gug drug pa rtse gsum pa'o/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwām̐ ka/ bzhi pa thod khrag lnga pa rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ spyan gsum la mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thod pa lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs 'phyang ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung ba snying rje rngam zhing zhi ba'i gar dang ldan pa/

'od kyi dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar// de yi shes rab phag mo ni/ dmar mo kha dog cher 'bar ma// lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// rdo rje dang ni mi thod 'chang*// rgyan rnams kyis brgyan snyoms par 'jug /de nas de ma thag tu snga ma ltar zhal dang go cha dang*/ sku gsung thugs dang mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa dang chas su bltas la/ lha thams cad rab tu gsal bar mos la/ de dang dus gcig lha thams cad bde ba chen po'i sbyor bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad bskul nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du zhugs te/ he ru ka nyid la rdzogs par blta bar byas te/ thugs kar pad ma dang nyi ma la he ru ka phag mo dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ mchod pa bzhi dang bcas pa'o// spyi bo gtsug dang rna ba g.yas// ltag pa rna ba g.yon de bzhin// smin dbus mig dang 'phrag pa la// gnas dang nye gnas thugs 'khor lo// mchan khung nu ma lte ba dang*// sna rtse kha dang mgrin pa dang*// snying kha lgang pa gsung 'khor lo/ zhing dang tshan dho ha la sogs// mtshan ma gshang lam brla gnyis dang*// byin pa sor mo rkang bol dang*// mthe bong pus mo sku 'khor lo// 'du ba dur khrod sogs rang bzhin// kha dog dbyibs kun sngar bstan bzhin/ pu li ra sogs phyi dang nang*// dbyer med rtsa dang khams rang bzhin// dbang po'i sgo rnams ma mo brgyad// thams cad gnyis su med bsam nas// ye shes dam tshig yang dag 'gyur// de phyir 'di dor can zhes brjod/ dbang bskur go 'phang bsam byas te// phyi nas mchod pa yang dag brtsal// de nas thugs kha'i bcom ldan 'das la sngags bkod de nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po spros la sngon nyid nas grub pa rnams mchod de 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ phreng gi sgras bkug nas/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hos dbyer med par byas te/ deng dus cig tu/ oṃ sarba bhi ra yo ki ni ka yā wag tsi ta badzra sa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/

oṃ yo ga shud dho sarba dhar ma yo ga shud dho ham̐/ oṃ ha na ma hi sa hā hūm̐/ sāau sha ṭa te hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa ham̐/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yam̐ hiṃ mam̐/ hrim hrim hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥ zhes sku gsung thugs dang rnal 'byor dang go cha brtan par byas nas mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bum pa rnams kyis he ru ka rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā gha tā a bāe ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī ye hūm̐/ ces dbang bskur nas spyi bor bcom ldan 'das la rdo rje sems dpa'/ lha mo rnams la rnam snang*/ bde ba chen po la rin 'byung*/ thugs la mi bskyod pa/ gsung la 'od dpag med/ sku la rnam snang*/ dam tshig la don yod grub pas brgyan par byas nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba ni me rlung gi sbyor bas gtor ma ltar bsam mo// de nas byang chub kyi phyogs kyis rnam par dag pa bsgom par bya ste/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba dran pa nye bar bzhag pa lā ma/ chos dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dum skyes ma/ sems dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gzugs can ma'o// 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rab tu gtum mo/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa gtum mig ma/ spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa 'od ldan ma/ sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis rkang pa sna chen ma'o// dad pa'i dbang po dpa' ba'i blo gros ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po mi thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po shing grib ma/ shes rab kyi dbang po sa srung ma'o// dad pa'i stobs 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs rlung gi shugs can ma/ dran pa'i stobs chang 'thungs ma/

ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs lha mo/ shes rab kyi stobs shin tu bzang mo/ ting 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag rta rna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag mkha' 'gro gdong ma/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ shin tu sbyang pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dum skyes ma/ chos rab tu 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag chang 'tshong ma/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag shin tu dpa' mo'o// yang dag pa'i lta ba stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa 'khor lo bsgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag brtson che ma/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' khwa gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i tshor ba 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i brtsol ba khyi gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa phag gdong ma/ dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i gshin rje'i sreg ma/ dge ba'i chos skyes pa bsrung ba gshin rje pho nya mo/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba gshin rje'i mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa ni/ gshin rje'i 'joms ma'o// yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dpal he ru ka'o// zhes mchog gi dag pa'o// de nas rtsa dang khams rnam par dag pa ni/ dbu ma la gnas pa'i dpyid ni thig le dkar ba ste he ru ka'o// thig le a thung ni phag mo'o// snying kha'i rtsa brgyad kyis phyogs kyis 'byung ba bzhi'i khams ni mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// mtshams kyis rtsa ba las byung ba'i khams mig la sogs pa'i dbang po bzhi bskyed pa ni mchod pa bzhi'o// pu li ra ma la yang mgo bo nas so dang sen mo 'bab pa'o// dzwa lan dha ra spyi gtsug nas skra dang ba spu dang u rgyan rna ba g.yas pa nas lpags pa dang dri ma/ ar bu ta ltag pa'i rtsa nas sha/ ko ta ri rna ba g.yon pa'i rtsa nas chu ba/ ra me sha ra smin dbus nas rus pa/ dhe bī ko ṭa mig gi rtsa nas mchin pa/

ma la bā dpung ba'i rtsa nas mig gi sha 'bab pa'o// ka ma ru pa mchan khung gnyis rtsa nas mig gi sha 'bab pa'o// oṃ ṭa nu ma'i rtsa nas 'khris pa dang*/ tri sha ku ni lte ba'i rtsa nas glo ba/ ko sa la sna'i rtsa nas rgyu ma/ ka li ka kha nas grod pa'i sha/ lam pa ka mchu nas gnye ma bskyed cing 'bab pa ste/ mi phyed ma nas brtse ba ma'i bar ro// yang gzhol ma nas kan tsi snying kha nas 'brel ba'i rtsas gshang ba/ hi ma la ya rgyu zhabs nas 'tshogs srub kyi sha 'bab pa'o// pre ta pu ra mtshan ma nas bad kan bskyed do// ghri ha de bā gshang lam nas rnag so'u raṣṭa brla'i rtsa nas khrag swau rba rna dhi sa byin pa nas rngul/ na ga ra song mo nas tshil sin dhu/ rkang bol nas mchil ma/ ma ru mthe bong nas mchil ma/ ku lu ta pus mo nas snabs bskyed cing 'babs pa'o// de ltar rtsa ni dpa' mo khams dpa' bo rnam par gnas pa'o// de nas mchod pa ni/ rang bzhin la rig ma bcu drug dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa la sogs pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod nas/ rkang pa brgyad pa la sogs pas bstod par bya'o// bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas/ sa bon la spro bsdu'am/ 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'am/ mda'i shugs lta bu la sogs pas bzlas so// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni thog mar nges par gsungs pa/ snying gi nang gnas pad ma ni/ 'dab ma brgyad par snying khar bcas// de'i dbus su gnas pa'i rtsa// mar me lta bu'i ngo bo nyid// chu shing gi ni me tog bzhin// 'phyang zhing kha ni 'og tu bltas// de yi dbus gnas dpa' bo ni// smin mtshams su thig le yungs dkar tsam pa ste// ba mo lta bur 'dzag pa nyid// lus can rnams kyis snying dga' ba// dpyid ces bya ba rnam par bshad// rgod ma'i me 'dra'i ngo bo ni// phag mo'i thig ler 'dod pa ste// las kyi rlung gis dpur ba yis// lte bas dkyil 'khor 'dir 'bar ba'o// dpyid thob nas ni tshim 'gyur ro// snyoms par 'jug par rnam par gnas// 'di dag khrag 'thung dpal dpa' bo// dpyid dang thig le 'dod pa ste// zhes bya ba ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya gtum mo bstan te/

stong pa nyid kyi tshul blangs nas/ rgyu dang mi rgyu yang dag gnas// sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis// sgo ni rnam pa gsum 'byung bar// 'gro ba dang ni 'ong bar byed// ces bya ba ni phyag rgya chen po'o// 'di ni kun gyi lus la gnas// lte bar a yig gzugs su ste// thung ngu ru ni rab tu grags// snying kha yang ni yi ge hūm̐// ring po'i tshad ni gnyis su nas// mgrin par oṃ yig gzungs kyis te/ tshad gsum shin tu ring zhes brjod// dpral ba ru ni yi ge ha// na da thig le gzhom med pa'o// 'khor lo bzhi yi rab dbye bas// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// thun bzhir byin gyis brlabs pa ni// pad ma bzhi ni yang dag 'byung*// dga' ba bzhi'i ngo bo dang*// rnal 'byor bzhi ru gzhol ba yis// mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo yis// bya dang byed pas dngos po ru// rdo rje sems dpa' rang bzhin gyis// 'di ni ci ltar bde bar rtse// zhes bya ba ni bde ba chen po'i rim pa rgyas pa'o// phyogs bzhir rnam par gnas pa ni// 'dab ma bzhi po rnams la spangs// 'byung ba bzhi yi rtsa rnams ni// mar me lta bu'i ngo bo nas// mtshams su rnam par gnas pa'i rtsa// de ru gnas pa bzhi po dag /de yang bdud rtsi lnga babs pas// de ni mchod pa'i ngo bor brten// de dngos kho na'i rang bzhin gyis// mchod pa bzhi zhes rnam par bshad// 'dir ni lus kyi snying dkyil nas// rtsa brgyad dag tu rnam par gnas// sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba gzhan// nyi shu rtsa bzhir brjod pa'o// gnas sogs pa la brten byas nas// gnas dang gnas su yang dag nas// lhung byed la sogs rnam dag pas// bya rog gdong sogs sngar ci bzhin// bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis ni// phyag rgya gdab gyur gnas zhes gsungs// zhes bya ba ni snga ma'i nges pa dang*/ sa bon dang bcas pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa'i rim pa rgyas par mdzad pa'o// sngags rnams dang gtor ma ni thams cad du gsungs pas ma bris so// mdor bsdus na ci srid dkyil 'khor dang gtum mo bsgoms pa las skyo na lha thams cad yi ge oṃ aḥhūm̐ ham̐ la bsdus la bde stong gis ngang du rnam par mi rtog par bzhag pa ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// he ru ka dpal lung bstan bstan chos gyis cig ces// gnang nas nag po gzhung drug rgyud las legs bsdus pa/

rmad byung bskyed rims yi ge bsdus la don rgyas pas// bod 'dir rnam dbye ma nus dor ba bzhin du gyur// de phyir cho ga'i skabs su gzhan la phan bsams nas// bsgoms pa'i rim par rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa la/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bzod par mdzod// dngos grub rgya cher gsol na// sems can thams cad rdo rje theg pas grol bar shog dpal nag po pas mdzad pa'i mngal skyes kyi bskyed rims bsgoms pa'i rim pa bde chen stengs su byi ba'i lo la mdzad pa dge'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
